Financial Controls is closing the evidence file for The Travelers Companies, Inc. activity-based expense allocation methodology. Review the Travelers FY2024 ABC Management Approval Memo and Travelers Expense Allocation Methodology and Controls, then reconcile them to the approval trail and evidence inventory in ServiceNow GRC case AMC-2025-0917. The approval history contains a non-final evidence review as well as the governing committee decision, and the inventory contains one superseded draft workbook that is no longer attached. Determine which action actually established the approved methodology, how the draft workbook must be treated, and why the fiscal year 2024 statutory and U.S. GAAP results remain unchanged.

Append one Evidence Certification in ServiceNow GRC for the affected workbook evidence. Record it as Accepted, attested by Michael T. Callahan on September 29, 2025, and use the certification notes to preserve the complete disposition and approval rationale. Do not revise the historical evidence record, the approval history, or any unrelated GRC data.

Also create a new concise DOCX control memo in the Governance and Approval folder. The memo should identify the evidence and source workbook, state its checksum and disposition, explain its retained follow-up role and why it cannot establish final approval, identify the authoritative approval body and date, state the activation period, and document the fiscal year 2024 no-restatement conclusion. Leave both existing governance documents unchanged.

In your final response, report the evidence record and condition you found, distinguish the non-final review from the authoritative approval, summarize the no-restatement basis, identify the ServiceNow certification you recorded, and name the new memo you created.
